summary: The note is a short Wikipedia-style profile of Gavin Bradley, a Toronto-based Canadian singer-songwriter and producer. It describes his work fusing acoustic and electronic elements, with a signature warm piano sound, live strings and filtered synthesizers, and notes his collaborations with Nelly Furtado, Tori Amos and Jane Siberry. It also mentions that he records as a solo artist and that his debut album, Deep Freeze, came out on UMI Records in 2006.
one_line: Toronto-based Canadian singer-songwriter and producer known for a warm piano sound blending acoustic and electronic elements, and his 2006 debut album Deep Freeze.
key_facts: Gavin Bradley is an award-winning Canadian singer-songwriter and producer based in Toronto.
Gavin Bradley has worked with artists including Nelly Furtado, Tori Amos and Jane Siberry.
Gavin Bradley's work fuses acoustic and electronic elements.
Gavin Bradley's work is identifiable for its signature "warm" piano sound.
Gavin Bradley's music features live strings mixed with filtered synthesizers and other electronic manipulations.
Besides production, Gavin Bradley is a solo recording artist.
Gavin Bradley's debut album, 'Deep Freeze', was released on UMI Records in 2006.
